state_residential_care.regulator: Texas Health and Human Services Commission (HHSC)
state_residential_care.program: Assisted Living Facilities (Type A, Type B; Alzheimer certification)
state_residential_care.notes: Excel directory, closures and a time-bounded violations PDF. Keep Type A / Type B distinct.

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.
Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.
Develop and implement a complete care plan that meets all the resident's needs, with timetables and actions that can be measured.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure drugs and biologicals used in the facility are labeled in accordance with currently accepted professional principles; and all drugs and biologicals must be stored in locked compartments, separately locked, compartments for controlled drugs.
Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide pharmaceutical services to meet the needs of each resident and employ or obtain the services of a licensed pharmacist.
Provide safe and appropriate respiratory care for a resident when needed.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Inspect, test, and maintain automatic sprinkler systems.
Safeguard resident-identifiable information and/or maintain medical records on each resident that are in accordance with accepted professional standards.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure smoke barriers are constructed to a 1 hour fire resistance rating.
Provide care and assistance to perform activities of daily living for any resident who is unable.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Timely report suspected abuse, neglect, or theft and report the results of the investigation to proper authorities.
top_deficiency_types.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies
